bugs.title: DB_UPDATE_CONCURRENCY error on createOrderFromCart returns graphql errors[] in 200 response with no UI feedback
bugs.failedAssertion: incidental — UI shows no error when createOrderFromCart returns errors[]
bugs.stepsToReproduce: 1. Navigate to /cart as logged-in user with item in cart and CyberSource form filled. 2. Click Place Order. 3. Monitor network — createOrderFromCart mutation returns HTTP 200 with body {errors:[{message:'Error trying to resolve field createOrderFromCart.',extensions:{code:'DB_UPDATE_CONCURRENCY'}}],data:{createOrderFromCart:null}}. 4. Observe cart page — no error message displayed; page stays on /cart silently.
bugs.expected: If createOrderFromCart returns GraphQL errors[], user should see an error message (e.g., 'Something went wrong. Please try again.')
bugs.actual: Cart page appears unchanged with no visible error. User has no indication the operation failed. Only detectable via network inspection.
